requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%
requirements.evidence: No ageing test data was found in project documents showing that R3 exceeds the 10% transparency loss threshold. While R3 is porous without explicit hydrophobic treatment (medium risk), no actual test failures were documented. The constraint is satisfied based on available information.
Recommended thickness of 3 cm is within the specified 1-6 cm range.
